criteria.statement: @tabler/icons-svelte is installed and locked for the web app.
web/src/lib/icons/domain-icons.js exports semantic icon aliases and blossomContentTypeIcon.
EmptyState, Table, Card, Modal, and ConfirmDialog support additive icon contracts without breaking legacy callers.
Blossom MIME type mapping returns non-emoji icon components with a generic fallback.
Route page conversion remains out of scope for this foundation bucket.
